groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: New leak site, first seen early Nov 2026. Posts “verified set of records” write-ups with ~4-day “full data leak” timers, often after a “Name upcoming” placeholder. Mixed geography, many SMEs in the Americas and Africa.
groups.countries: Mexico, United States, South Africa, Vietnam, Botswana
groups.sectors: Retail, IT services, manufacturing, healthcare, security services, payments, SaaS

groups.name: LockBit5
groups.profile: LockBit 5.0, the RaaS relaunched in 2025 after the 2024 Operation Cronos takedown. Today’s posts are bare domain listings with truncated blurbs, posted in a 5-minute burst.

groups.name: HYFLOCK
groups.profile: Active since Oct 2026 (DeXpose), with victims across Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe and Australia. RedPacket flags HYFLOCK listings as possibly unverified/fabricated, so treat as low-confidence. Uses descriptive titles (“An independent asset management firm in Casablanca”) in place of names.
groups.sectors: Media, textiles, real estate, asset management

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: First seen July 2025; ~700 claimed victims in a year (Cybernews), reportedly grew out of a Qilin affiliate cluster. Known for GPO-based deployment, scheduled tasks, PowerShell and log clearing (Huntress).
groups.countries: United States, Sweden, Taiwan, not disclosed

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Active since March 2023 (CISA AA24-109A). Double extortion with Windows/ESXi encryptors; frequently abuses VPNs without MFA. Standard “we will upload N GB” posts.

groups.name: Helix
groups.profile: Little-documented. Claims publication via GoFile archive tiers (T1–T4) with record and file counts.

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-sale/extortion site tracked since Sep 2026. Today it dumped 25 anonymous entries (#217–#241, all masked). Ransomware.live maps it to Valid Accounts (T1078).

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS (Agenda) since 2022, among the most active brands of 2025–26.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (CISA AA23-319A). Auctions data and publishes detailed inventories of accounting books, mailboxes and AD databases.

groups.name: Silent Ransom Group
groups.profile: Also known as Luna Moth / Chatty Spider; runs callback-phishing data-theft extortion without encryption, and the FBI warned in May 2025 that it targets U.S. law firms. Shown as “leakeddata” on RansomLook.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: “AOQIN Leaks”, tracked since 4 Nov 2026. Posts revenue, staff, data types and publication dates with “not paid” status.

groups.name: Direwolf
groups.profile: Double-extortion brand tracked since 2025. Today’s post is a bare listing.

groups.name: Emperador
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site. Posts document counts, size and a ~10-day publication date.

groups.name: Krybit
groups.profile: Little-documented. Bare domain listings with truncated directory-style profiles.

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: RaaS since 2019 (CISA AA22-181A), mainly via exposed RDP. Today’s post cites only an email-count extract.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: Emerged Oct 2026 (first victim 21 Oct per Cybernews).
